newsitem.title: UK: Tennis star Henman to appear in Kellogg's ad.
newsitem.headline: Tennis star Henman to appear in Kellogg's ad.

text.p: British tennis star Tim Henman will make his advertising debut with a television ad for Kellogg's Sustain cereal that will run in conjunction with the Australian Open, Kellogg said on Tuesday.

The 30-second ad, which features the 22-year-old Henman on the court hitting serves, will be broadcast only on Sky television, the satellite television channel owned by British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc. Henman is the only British tennis player participating in the Australian Open, which begins January 13.
The ad, part of a series featuring athletes to promote Sustain, was shot on location in South Africa.

A spokeswoman for Kellogg, the U.S.-based cereal maker, declined to detail the amount spent on the ad campaign or the amount paid to Henman. She said that Henman was appearing only in this one ad, although it could be used again at a later time.
Kellogg said Sustain is the only cereal specifically designed, in association with the Australian Institute of Sport, to meet the nutritional needs of athletes.
